bukhari-6984.title: A true good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Satan
bukhari-6984.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of Dreams (Kitab at-Ta’bir), hadith 6984
bukhari-6984.supports: The hadith distinguishes a true good dream (from Allah) from a bad dream (from Satan), establishing that dreams are not all the same kind of experience.

bukhari-6985.title: Good dreams: thank Allah and share; bad dreams: seek refuge and stay quiet
bukhari-6985.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of Dreams (Kitab at-Ta’bir), hadith 6985
bukhari-6985.supports: The hadith gives the traditional response to a good dream (thank Allah, narrate it) and to a bad dream (seek refuge in Allah from its evil, do not dwell on it).

bukhari-6986.title: A good dream that comes true is from Allah, a bad dream is from Satan
bukhari-6986.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of Dreams (Kitab at-Ta’bir), hadith 6986
bukhari-6986.supports: The hadith teaches that a bad dream will not harm the one who seeks refuge in Allah from Satan, and includes the etiquette of spitting lightly to the left.

muslim-2263a.title: Dreams are of three types
muslim-2263a.reference: Sahih Muslim, Book of Dreams (Kitab al-Ru'ya), hadith 2263a
muslim-2263a.supports: The hadith explicitly describes three types of dreams: a good dream which is good tidings from Allah, an evil dream which causes pain and is from the satan, and a dream which is a suggestion of one's own mind. It also teaches that a disliked dream should not be related to people.
